THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STREET & CITY
175
STUDY 049
Black Collared Dress with Cream Trim
Rights check
Source: 24378.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with soft, shoulder-length
light brown waves sits on a stone ledge in front of a
weathered stone wall. She wears a fitted black
short-sleeve knit dress with a cream collar, cream
placket, and pearl buttons, with cream trim at the cuffs
and hem. A simple gold bracelet sits on one wrist. Her
expression is calm and composed, looking toward the
camera. Soft natural daylight, a palette of black, cream,
and warm stone. Refined and classic, in the style of a
timeless street portrait.
Refined, classic, composed
WORKING NOTES
- The cream trim and pearl buttons are the key details.
- Keep the stone wall for a classic architectural backdrop.
Try this: Keep the stone wall as the backdrop.
